dialogues.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
dialogues.text: Oh my gosh... T-T-T-Tumaini!? Are you on a secret mission? Is that why you have to keep your identity hidden?

dialogues.speaker: Little Pinecone
dialogues.text: Is there anything we can do to help? We may not be very strong, but if you have a task for us, we'll give it everything we've got!

choices.text: Then here's your task: let's all grow stronger together.

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: Th-Then we've already begun! We've been training hard, and we won't let you down!

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: Chichikova told us to use the Kamera to observe all kinds of little animals, so we went and learned from the hunters how to get close without startling them...

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: That skill is called "stealth," right? The warriors of the Masters of the Night-Wind are really good at it. Maybe we could even use it in competitions!

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: A-And, and! We've been taking the manual with us and going all over the place, but there's so much deep snow on the roads, and the blizzards are super strong...

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: So we need to get used to the cold, too! And we have to learn how to use lots of new ice sculptures!

choices.text: Why don't you tell me a little about yourselves first?

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: Um... W-We're on a training trip.

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: Little Pinecone's dad — Uncle Amuru, the Sand Dagger of Seit'aad — taught us lots of fighting moves.

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: But Dad said since we've always stayed in Natlan, we don't know enough about warriors from other places, and that won't do.

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: So he gave us a great big bunch of travel money and sent us all the way to Snezhnaya for some serious training.

choices.text: He let two kids travel all the way to another country by themselves...?

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: H-Hey, we're not little kids anymore! I'm already twelve, and Little Pinecone is ten!

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: They say Varesa from the Collective of Plenty had already beaten hundreds of monsters when she was our age.

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: Just a few more years, and we'll be official tribal warriors too, like Kinich and Lord Ajaw!

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: This trip is just for training, really. We only followed Chichikova around and practiced boxing and wrestling with a few big white bears.

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: We didn't pick fights with anyone super scary, so we'll be totally fine!

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: Dad says if you stay in a nice, comfy place all the time, your body and brain both get slow.

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: Da Xi'er also said people in Liyue work hard with a certain kind of attitude... Umm... what was the word for it again?

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: ...Being ready for danger, even during peaceful times?

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: Right, right! That's the one!

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: If we're always ready for bad guys to pop up, and we keep training as hard as we can, then we won't panic when something really bad happens.

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: And next time Natlan needs more warriors, Wood Figure and I are both gonna step up and help!

choices.text: Your dad's got some serious nerve...
No worries. I won't interrupt your fun.

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: W-Wait! I... I don't mind being interrupted by Tumaini...

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: Hmm... But Tumaini still seems busy... When you have time later, please come play with us! Even if it's only for a few minutes!
